parsedVerdict.reasoning: This module has a single file, src/auth/entity/user.entity.ts, which declares one class, UserEntity. The class covers one concern: how a user is stored and how its password is handled. It has the user's columns (username, email, password, salt, token, the 2FA fields and the role relation). Its behaviour is all about the password: hashing it, the insert and update hooks, and checking it. The class builds on the project's CustomBaseEntity base class rather than going around it. The password-hashing logic stays inside this class. Both hooks, hashPasswordBeforeInsert and hashPasswordBeforeUpdate, call the shared hashPassword() method. validatePassword uses the same bcrypt-with-this.salt approach, so the hashing rule is not spread across the file. The one small repeat is the check `this.password && !this.skipHashPassword`, which appears in both hooks. It is only a few characters in one file and does not split the logic or bypass anything. The file has no unrelated parts, no rule copied elsewhere in the module, and no bypassed abstraction. Import direction and the fact that bcrypt and TypeORM are used in the domain layer are out of scope.
